entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail relating to RCT No.4836/2025 registered in the Court of Judicial Magistrate First Class, Jabalpur for commission of offence under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 of the IPC.

entities.text: Court of Judicial Magistrate First Class, Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. As per the prosecution case, respondent No. 2 had filed a criminal complaint against the applicant and others before the Court of Magistrate under Section 200 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for offences under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal Code, which was dismissed on 30/05/2024, finding no sufficient grounds under the said sections.
The Respondent No

. 2 challenged the said order by filing a Criminal Revision Petition before the Sessions Court, Jabalpur,
which was 2 MCRC-10329-2026 registered as Criminal Revision No.304/2024 and was allowed on 17/03/2025 and a copy was sent to the Subordinate Court.

The Subordinate Court has registered a regular criminal case No. 4836/2025 under sections 406, 420, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal Code against the applicant and others and arrest warrants have been issued for presence of the applicant.
When the police reached the applicant house in her absence to arrest her, it was found that arrest warrants for the presence of the applicant have been issued from the court of Judicial Magistrate.
First Class, Jabalpur.

Respondent No. 2 has stated that her husband without obtaining a divorce,
has performed marriage with present applicant and submitted an affidavit to the divisional office of the Municipal Corporation, Jabalpur, stating her name as Seema alias Rekha Gupta, 'wife of Abhishek Gupta, resident of Mahatma Gandhi Ward, Jabalpur.

entities.text: divisional office of the Municipal Corporation, Jabalpur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: She also submitted affidavits identifying Rekha Gupta as Seema Gupta in the Samaggra ID number 34577736 and member ID number 159922080, respectively.

Her father's name is shown as Govardhan on her Aadhaar card,
and she submitted a fake Samagra ID.
Consequently, the applicant and others have committed offenses punishable under the aforementioned sections, for which a complaint was filed.
Upon finding the occurrence of offenses under those sections, a case was registered and an arrest warrant has been issued for the applicant's appearance.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
She is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
The applicant is a woman and she has no criminal antecedent.
It is further contended that the Magistrate once had passed the order, he cannot review 3 MCRC-10329-2026 the order.

It is also contended that she will be available for interrogation and,
therefore considering the totality of facts and circumstances of the case, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4 .
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State and the counsel appearing for the objector have opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

It is submitted by them that there is specific role attributed to the present applicant and hence anticipatory bail should not be granted.
5.
I have heard counsel for the parties.
There is specific role attributed to the present applicant.

She performed marriage with the husband of the respondent No.2 without divorce from the respondent No.2 and submitted an affidavit to the divisional office of the Municipal Corporation, Jabalpur stating her name as Seema @ Rekha Gupta wife of Abhishek Gupta and also manipulated the Samagra ID and Member ID.

Looking to the seriousness of the allegations which requires further detail investigation, this Court is of the opinion it is not a fit case where anticipatory bail should be granted to the applicant.
6. Accordingly, the M.Cr.C. is dismissed.

(SANDEEP N. BHATT) JUDGE ks Seema vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 31 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145459716/
